dedupe_keys.name: radsim web based cycling traffic simulation for municipal cycle planning germany

description: RadSim is a web-based tool that lets German municipalities run cycling traffic simulations to plan infrastructure measures and estimate their effects. It combines established and new transport research methods, with analysis and forecast models based on empirical cycling demand data, and simulates measures such as the routing of cycle traffic, surface quality and permitted motor vehicle speeds; it offers impact analysis with forecasts of traffic shifts and before-and-after comparisons, and supports prioritising measures. The dashboard shows the network, the simulation and a difference map. It is a joint research and practice project under the National Cycling Plan (NRVP), run by Cyface GmbH, and was developed with pilot municipalities including Cottbus, Freising, Leipzig, Wedel, Freiburg, Weimar, Bietigheim-Bissingen, Offenburg, Dresden, Eschborn and Lüchow-Dannenberg. Coverage is German municipalities. It is used in a web browser after registration, with a guide for users; no licence or price is stated on the page. Caveats: the models and code are not published, and results depend on the demand data available for each municipality. RadSim supports capacity and network planning of cycling infrastructure and before-and-after evaluation. It complements the PeopleForBikes Bicycle Network Analysis catalogued here.
